correctness.rationale: Fourier basis diagonalizes the H=J(A⊗I+I⊗A) bosonic Kronecker sum. In each total Walsh momentum k and energy index r, every symmetric Fourier pair has the same nonzero coincidence vector proportional to character k, so detector rank exactly one; different total momenta have independent diagonal characters. Number of bright blocks sums to 2^(d-1)(d+2); bosonic dimension 2^(d-1)(2^d+1), giving dark dimension 2^(d-1)(2^d-d-1). For distinct sites at Hamming s, sum bright overlaps via Krawtchouk row orthogonality, yielding eta_d(s)=2 sum_{j=s}^d C(d,j)/(2^d C(d,s)). Positivity of all collision rates gives asymptotic decay outside maximal invariant diagonal-null space. Strictly decreasing tail follows by ratio product. Boundary d=2, s=d checked; d=1 appears only as finite diagnostic. Independent spectral reconstruction confirms d=2,3 including all s; exact arithmetic formulas checked d=2..6; finite tests do not establish the all-d statement.
